acceptanceCriteria: a documented operator path produces a consistent store snapshot while writers may be active (or refuses with a named quiesce requirement), with a test
a snapshot can be bound to a new primary worktree by an explicit, receipted relocate step, or the spec records relocation as a non-goal and names the supported qualification alternative
V1-1459's criteria are reconciled with the outcome
body: Observed 2026-10-16, corvint-tasks build 558, during the V1-1459 lane (qualify CAL-V0-017 on a copied store). (1) `cp -R` of the live .git/taskman into a plain clone's .git while the live store was being written: every read refused JOURNAL_FORKED (head names receipt 000000006372.json which is absent). (2) A fresh copy: every read refused UNSUPPORTED_FILESYSTEM because head.primaryWorktree is /Users/russelllewis/projects/corvint, differing from the copy's path ('repository relocation is unsupported in this preview'). Expected: an operator can produce a consistent, isolated copy of a store for off-path qualification or recovery drills (quiesced export/snapshot plus an explicit relocate/rebind step), without editing head.json. Actual: no supported path; V1-1459's acceptance criteria cannot be met as written.
title: corvint-tasks: a copied store cannot be read off its original path (UNSUPPORTED_FILESYSTEM) and a copy taken during writes is JOURNAL_FORKED
